[[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] from the [[Bomu Clan]] stored [[Tempest (spice)|tempest]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] in a '''warehouse''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]] for distribution on that world. After the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Toro Irana]] [[Death/Legends|died]] of mysterious circumstances on Makem Te, his [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mander Zuma]], investigated. His search led him to the warehouse, where he came under fire from Bomu Rodians and their [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] lackeys. Zuma was joined by [[Reen Irana]], sister of the deceased, and her friend, the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Eddey Be'ray]], who helped him escape the warehouse.
